newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Etec Systems started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Etec Systems started.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Friday it initiated coverage of Etec Systems Inc with a hold rating and a 12-month price target of $45 to reflect the volatility of quarterly earnings.

-- Etec, a maker of mask pattern generation equipment, will be able to diversify into new markets in the third quarter when it introduces its Polyscan products, ABN AMRO said. Polyscan, applicable in the manufacture of printed circuit boards, multi-chip modules and flat panel displays, is estimated to account for eight percent of Etec's total revenues in fiscal 1998, ABN AMRO said.
-- Etec shares were up 1-3/8 Friday at 31-5/8.
